tasks.title: Monorepo + uv workspace scaffolding
tasks.description: Create the monorepo with a uv workspace containing the six packages (SDK, engine, and four connectors) using src layout, with shared pyproject conventions.
inputs: RS-08 connector SDK spec (package topology section)
tasks.dod: uv workspace resolves all six packages; each importable with an empty src package; `uv sync` succeeds.
tasks.verify: uv sync && uv run python -c 'import qlabs_catalog_sync_sdk'

tasks.title: Tooling config: ruff, mypy strict, pytest, pre-commit
tasks.description: Configure ruff, mypy (strict), pytest plus pytest-asyncio, and pre-commit across the workspace with shared settings.
tasks.dod: ruff, mypy --strict, and an empty pytest run all pass locally with the shared config.
tasks.verify: uv run ruff check . && uv run mypy

tasks.title: CI pipeline: lint, type-check, test, build wheels
tasks.description: Create the CI pipeline that runs lint, type-check, and tests, and builds a wheel per package.
tasks.dod: CI runs ruff + mypy + pytest and builds a wheel per package on push.
tasks.verify: uv run ruff check . && uv run mypy

tasks.title: Contributor docs: boundaries & dependency rules
tasks.description: Document package boundaries, the dependency rule that connectors depend only on the SDK, and the ADR location. (No Markdown under tools/; place docs in the repo docs area.)
tasks.dod: Contributor guide states package boundaries + connector->SDK-only rule and points to ADR location.
tasks.verify: uv sync && uv run python -c 'import qlabs_catalog_sync_sdk'

tasks.title: Neutral model types (pydantic v2)
tasks.description: Implement the neutral model types with pydantic v2: DataProduct, Dataset, GlossaryTerm, Category, Party, Tag, FieldEnvelope, IdentityRef, FieldDiff.
inputs: RS-03 neutral metadata model spec sections 1-3 (entities & envelopes)
tasks.dod: All neutral entities are defined, validate, and serialize round-trip; mypy strict clean.

tasks.title: Connector ABC + contract types
tasks.description: Define the Connector abstract base class (capabilities/setup/healthcheck/list_changed/read/create/update/delete) and contract types EntityType, Watermark, ChangeRef, WriteResult, HealthStatus.
inputs: RS-08 connector SDK spec sections 2-3 (connector contract)
tasks.dod: Connector ABC and all contract types compile, are typed, and a stub subclass can be instantiated.

tasks.title: CapabilityManifest types
tasks.description: Implement CapabilityManifest types: EntityCapability, FieldCapability (mode rw/ro/na), partial_update, and concurrency descriptors.
inputs: RS-08 connector SDK spec section 4 (capability manifest)
tasks.dod: Manifest model expresses per-entity/field rw/ro/na, partial_update, and concurrency; validates.

tasks.title: HTTP helper + retry/backoff + pagination
tasks.description: Build the httpx wrapper (base URL, auth injection, timeouts, pooling), tenacity retry/backoff honoring 429/Retry-After, and pagination helpers.
inputs: RS-08 connector SDK spec section 5 (HTTP/retry helpers)
tasks.dod: HTTP helper retries on 429 honoring Retry-After and paginates; covered by unit tests with respx.

tasks.title: Auth providers base
tasks.description: Implement auth provider bases: API key, OAuth2 M2M, JWT/key-pair, with an in-memory token cache and refresh.
inputs: RS-08 connector SDK spec section 5 (auth providers)
tasks.dod: API-key, OAuth2 M2M, and JWT/key-pair providers issue and refresh cached tokens; unit tested.

tasks.title: Field envelope + canonical checksum utilities
tasks.description: Implement field envelope and canonical checksum utilities with deterministic normalization for stable diffing.
inputs: RS-03 neutral metadata model spec (field envelopes & checksums)
tasks.dod: Checksum is stable across reordering/formatting; identical logical values produce identical checksums.

tasks.title: Config base + ConnectorContext + typed exceptions
tasks.description: Implement the pydantic-settings config base, ConnectorContext, and typed exceptions (Transient/Auth/NotFound/Conflict/Capability).
inputs: RS-08 connector SDK spec section 6 (config, context, exceptions)
tasks.dod: Config base loads from env; ConnectorContext wired; all typed exceptions defined and raisable.

tasks.title: Conformance test kit
tasks.description: Build the reusable pytest conformance suite (contract, round-trip, idempotency, capability-honesty) plus a respx/vcr harness.
inputs: RS-08 connector SDK spec section 7 (conformance kit)
tasks.dod: Conformance kit runs against a fake connector and asserts contract, round-trip, idempotency, capability honesty.

tasks.title: Contract version + compatibility gate + entry-point group
tasks.description: Add the SDK contract version constant, the compatibility gate, the entry-point group, and packaging docs.
inputs: RS-08 connector SDK spec section 8 (versioning & discovery)
tasks.dod: Contract version constant exported; compatibility gate function present; entry-point group declared.

tasks.title: Entry-point discovery + connector registry + version gate
tasks.description: Implement entry-point-based connector discovery, a connector registry, and the SDK version gate.
inputs: RS-08 connector SDK spec section 8 (discovery & versioning)
tasks.dod: Engine discovers connectors via entry points, registers them, and rejects incompatible SDK versions.

tasks.title: State store: SQLAlchemy models + Alembic on SQLite
tasks.description: Implement the state store with SQLAlchemy 2.0 models (IdentityMap, watermarks, last-known field envelopes) and Alembic init on SQLite.
tasks.dod: SQLAlchemy models for identity map, watermarks, and envelopes migrate cleanly on SQLite via Alembic.

tasks.title: Config & secrets loading
tasks.description: Implement config and secrets loading for tenants/endpoints and secret backends via pydantic-settings.
tasks.dod: Engine loads tenant/endpoint config and resolves secrets from a configured backend.

tasks.title: Upstream sync loop (single transaction, idempotent)
tasks.description: Implement the upstream sync loop: poll source -> read to envelopes -> identity resolve -> checksum diff -> write to Qlik -> persist -> advance watermark, all in one transaction, with idempotent skip on no-op.
tasks.dod: One cycle reads, resolves, diffs, writes, persists, and advances watermark transactionally; re-run is a no-op.

tasks.title: Manual-edit-on-Qlik policy
tasks.description: Implement the manual-edit-on-Qlik policy: source-wins overwrite vs preserve-local, configurable per field/entity.
tasks.dod: Policy resolves conflicts per configured field/entity: source-wins by default, preserve-local when set.

tasks.title: Scheduler: APScheduler async, per-source cadence
tasks.description: Implement the scheduler using APScheduler AsyncIOScheduler (or an asyncio loop) with per-source cadence, jitter, and max_instances=1.
tasks.dod: Per-source jobs run on cadence with jitter and never overlap (max_instances=1).

tasks.title: Observability: structlog + prometheus + healthz/metrics
tasks.description: Implement observability: structlog context-bound logging, prometheus_client metrics, and a /healthz + /metrics HTTP surface.
tasks.dod: Structured logs carry sync context; /healthz and /metrics respond and expose sync metrics.

tasks.title: Dry-run mode
tasks.description: Implement dry-run mode: compute and log planned writes without applying them.
tasks.dod: Dry-run computes and logs the planned write set and performs zero mutations against Qlik.

tasks.title: Qlik auth (OAuth2 M2M) + endpoint config
tasks.description: Implement Qlik OAuth2 M2M auth and HttpEndpoint config with the tenant base URL.
tasks.dod: Connector authenticates to a Qlik tenant via OAuth2 M2M using configured base URL.
